title: Design
summary: Professional design in line with Latvian building regulations — from private homes to industrial facilities.
paragraphs: BasicAir designers are highly qualified professionals with experience developing projects of various types and scales, in accordance with Latvian building regulations.
Our designers provide modern, cost-optimal technical solutions that meet all fire safety and sanitary requirements. They work with modern design software that guarantees high project quality.

BasicAir designers will develop the best technical solution for you and advise on the most suitable equipment for different projects — private houses or apartments, as well as larger facilities such as industrial and production premises, warehouses and offices, schools and kindergartens, or catering spaces.
